WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS total_spent
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY CustomerId
), customer_shares AS (
  SELECT CustomerId, total_spent,
         total_spent / SUM(total_spent) OVER () AS share
  FROM customer_totals
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM customer_shares
)
SELECT AVG(cs.total_spent) AS average_total_spent,
       AVG(cs.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(cs.share - oa.average_share) AS average_share_difference
FROM customer_shares cs
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE cs.share > oa.average_share
